builder.objective: V2-06 phase 2 — Backend operational adapters (auth/sync/invitations/billing/permissions/SecureStorage/push/calendar) and remaining Research Analytics Plane features (query budget/rate limit, differential privacy capacity, consent/purpose/jurisdiction policy, buyer contracts, audit/export log).
builder.scope:
V2-06 phase 2 covers the backend operational half and remaining analytics features per ROADMAP.md V2-06 section.

Required — Backend operational:
1. Production-ready auth adapter or clearly bounded local-test adapter with honest contract (no fake OAuth).
2. Sync adapter with offline support, conflict resolution, and honest network boundary.
3. Invitations system: create/accept/decline household invitations.
4. Billing adapter provider-agnostic per household (honest port, no fake Stripe).
5. Member/owner/payer permission system enforced server-side.
6. SecureStorage adapter for sensitive data.
7. Push notification adapter behind honest port (no fake Firebase).
8. Calendar integration adapter behind honest port (no fake Google Calendar).
9. Purchase/entitlement restoration logic.
10. Tenant isolation and encryption documentation.
11. No secrets in repo, no fake active services.

Required — Research Analytics Plane (remaining):
12. Query budget/rate limit configuration for flexible analytics API.
13. Differential privacy capacity (epsilon/delta parameters) with configurable threshold.
14. Consent/purpose/jurisdiction configurable policy document and code types.
15. Buyer contracts types/interface prohibiting re-identification and unauthorized redistribution.
16. Audit/export log persistence for external data product releases.

Do NOT yet implement: actual network calls, actual payment processing, actual push delivery, actual calendar sync, actual OAuth flows. All external services remain behind honest ports with local adapters. The product must remain fully testable offline.

Preserve all V2-00..V2-05 invariants and V2-06 phase 1 invariants. No regression. Navigation stays 3 tabs. Premium contextuel non agressif.
